nine_checks_reconciliation_verdict.details: Direct GitHub API check-run and job inspection identifies exactly 5 failures on PR #729 head (with 1 additional neutral check) and exactly 5 failed jobs across workflow runs on merge commit 2c3501e. The external reviewer's count of 'nine failing checks' cannot be reconstructed from individual failed jobs alone. Possible origins include: (a) combining distinct non-passing checks across both commits, (b) counting skipped/cancelled matrix sub-jobs triggered by dependent failures, or (c) inspecting an intermediate push state prior to head a35bd4d. Because no authoritative 9-check failure ledger exists in the GitHub API record, the 'nine failing checks' claim is formally classified as having an UNRESOLVED historical basis.
